title: Papa, I want a Kapla duck that stands on 1 leg, in a tree. Use all 200 blocks.
subtitle: 200 planks (animal)
notes: 52-level crib trunk, deck, pinwheel leaf crown; one standing-plank leg; 41-plank crib body, 5-plank folded wings, two-prong tail, 13-level crossed neck, crib head, beak, centred crest. Order chosen to keep the weight over the leg.
Height 74.9 cm. Stands at exact positions after 200 of 200 steps; solid at 2 mm after 121.
Finished build: risky at 2 mm, solid at 1.95 mm, solid at 1 mm.
Whole plan fails at 2 mm: first at step 122 (risky).
